product_from_film: Jester is presented as an iMessage meme assistant for individual and group chats.

lessons.keep: Show the request and a large result inside the same communication scene.
lessons.avoid: Avoid hiding offer conditions or task detail behind rapidly changing backgrounds and slogans.
lessons.open: Audio, flash frequency, actual service behavior and free-offer conditions remain unverified.
try: For Tin, put one campaign-creative request beside its returned image, with the result large enough to judge.
Test a retro-window launch offer with only the benefit, limit and CTA, avoiding competing decorative windows.

comparison.story: Introduce character and channel. → Demonstrate a prompt and meme reply. → Show group-chat use and irreverent tone. → Give destination and platform limit. → Provide another example. → Close with a limited offer and sign-up prompt.
